name: ALL_A_EW_RET20
formula: All-A EW index = equal-weight mean of PIT-eligible non-ST stock daily returns (close/pre_close-1) on each trading day; compounded over past 20 trading days: prod(1+mean_ret)-1

name: ALL_A_EW_RET60
formula: All-A EW index 60-trading-day compounded return (same index as F01)

name: CSI300_RET20
formula: Official CSI300 index close ret over past 20 trading days (index_000300.parquet, no NA)

name: CSI1000_RET20
formula: Official CSI1000 index close ret over past 20 trading days (index_000852.parquet, no NA)

name: ALL_A_DISTANCE_MA20
formula: All-A EW index level (compounded from index daily returns, base 1.0 at 2020-01-02) / its MA20 - 1

name: ALL_A_MA20_SLOPE
formula: MA20(All-A EW index level) today / MA20 5 trading days ago - 1

name: BREADTH_MA20
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks (listed>=60 trading days, valid quote today) with close_adj > MA20(close_adj)

name: BREADTH_UP1D
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with close > pre_close today

name: BREADTH_NEWLOW20
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with close_adj <= min(close_adj over past 20 trading days incl today)

name: BREADTH_BELOW_BB
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with close_adj < BB(20,2) lower (MA20 - 2*std20, ddof=1, same def as frozen engine)

name: ALL_A_RV20
formula: Std of daily All-A EW index returns over past 20 trading days

name: ALL_A_RV60
formula: Std of daily All-A EW index returns over past 60 trading days

name: CROSS_SECTION_RET_STD
formula: Cross-sectional std of PIT-eligible non-ST stock daily returns today

name: DOWN_VOL_SHARE
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with daily return <= -5% today

name: MARKET_AMOUNT_RATIO20
formula: Today total market amount (sum of PIT-eligible non-ST amount) / mean of past 20 trading days' total amount

name: MARKET_AMOUNT_Z60
formula: (Today total market amount - mean(past 60 trading days)) / std(past 60); NaN until 60d history

name: MEDIAN_STOCK_AMOUNT_RATIO20
formula: Median over PIT-eligible non-ST stocks of (stock amount today / stock MA20 amount)

name: LIMIT_DOWN_SHARE
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with close <= limit_down_px (limit-down per frozen engine rule: pre_close*(1-pct), pct=0.20/0.10/0.05)

name: DROP5_SHARE
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with daily return <= -5%

name: DROP7_SHARE
formula: Fraction of PIT-eligible non-ST stocks with daily return <= -7%

name: CROSS_SECTION_P10_RET
formula: 10th percentile of PIT-eligible non-ST stock daily returns today

name: N_OVERSOLD_SIGNALS
formula: Number of frozen SECONDARY episodes with signal_date = t (== count of oversold signals that day, from frozen fullmarket_episode_metrics)

name: OVERSOLD_SIGNAL_SHARE
formula: F22 / PIT-eligible non-ST universe size on day t

name: N_OVERSOLD_Z60
formula: z-score of F22 over past 60 trading days (strict past window [t-60,t-1]); NaN until 60d

name: MRH_20_REALIZED
formula: Mean over last 20 completed-episode signal-days of per-signal-day mean realized episode return; only episodes with exit_date <= t (PIT, no future info)

name: MRH_60_REALIZED
formula: Same as F25 over last 60 completed-episode signal-days

name: MRH_WIN20_REALIZED
formula: Mean over last 20 completed-episode signal-days of per-signal-day realized win rate (return>0); only episodes with exit_date <= t
